profile.headline: Frontend Software Engineer at Figma
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Frontend software engineer at Figma with experience in Javascript, C++, CSS, and React. 










Previously: Frontend SWE at Apple







🍎 







Please include a fun cookie recipe 🍪

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Drove Figma’s push towards WCAG 2.2 Accessibility: built React & in-canvas features for keyboard users, consulted for product teams, built & tracked metrics
- Architected & implemented design system color token sharing for CSS & C++ & built an enhanced contrast mode in Figma supported across React UI & the canvas
- Led Figma’s gender minorities in engineering group, including leading talks & panels, organizing networking events, and facilitating mentorship relationships

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built web support for the photos Shared Library feature, working cross functionally with backend server teams, the native photos team, product, design, and marketing
- Overhauled the icloud.com iCloud Links infrastructure; led a team of 5 engineers over the course of three months, improving load time, reliability, and maintainability, building updated UI in React with SCSS and an updated data layer in Typescript
- Integrated shared albums & Apple Invites, while mentoring a junior engineer
positions.insights: Skills: Web Engineering · React.js · Web Development (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) · TypeScript · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Gathered requirements for, designed, mocked-up, & built a dashboard in Ember JS, streamlining curation workflow for editors and reducing external searches by 93%
- Optimized file uploads with a new Java service & Spring API for multipart uploads
- Improved frontend usability by adding a progress bar & error badges in Ember JS
- Enabled 10 important production features in a development environment in Java

company.name: University of Chicago Department of Computer Science

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Taught software development principles through instruction & assignment feedback
- Led sprint planning meetings, advised software design, reviewed pull requests, and
aided debugging for 3 5-student teams on a classwide, 8-week agile C software project

positions.title: Computer Science Grader
positions.description:
Provide constructive feedback on weekly homework assignments in Typed Racket
Support in-class learning through personalized comments and suggestions

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
Role:
Enabled Argonne’s scientists to easily find, replicate, and publish research 
Augmented the JupyterLab engine with a publication toolkit, iterated on features based on team feedback, utilized both familiar and new languages/technologies

Project:
Engineered a user-friendly, single-click process for importing and exporting research using Python, Typescript, HTML, CSS, Django, and Tornado
Wrote tests and documentation to support published extension

positions.title: Computer Science Core Tutor
positions.description:
Bolster students’ computer science learning by teaching debugging principles and other key concepts and helping them overcome project roadblocks
Improve students’ project scores by 50% or more, ease their testing anxiety

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
- Developed curriculum, edited projects, and helped redesign grading scheme for a software development class (CMSC 22000) pioneered the previous year
- Built a C parsing library, enabling the students to focus on project intricacies

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Introduced 20 high school girls to computer science through tailored daily lessons, hands-on activities, and real-world projects in Scratch, Javascript, and Python
- Boosted students’ confidence and encouraged them to pursue their passions for CS

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
Engaged K-8 students in math and coding, teaching complex concepts and sparking curiosity.
Created and implemented a six-week curriculum involving empirical data analysis for a gifted student who exceeded the existing level boundary at the company.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description: Designed schedules for efficient staffing, interfaced with parent clients, organized company materials, hired, integrated, and trained new employees, managed summer camp programs, and handled office correspondence.

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description: Tutored middle school and high school students in Physics, Pre-Algebra, Algebra I, Geometry, Algebra II, and Pre-Calculus. Increased student confidence and understanding of underlying concepts, improved grades significantly.
